prompt: Long-lens photo from across the road, cold morning, low sun through steel bridge girders striping the New York asphalt with shadow; a blurred passing car clips one edge. Small, half in shade by a riveted pillar, a lone figure faces the camera, microphone held out to the empty pavement. Baggy beige suit, full-length trousers to the shoes, black socks, black roll-neck, plain cap, black gloves into the cuffs. The balaclava has no eye, nose or mouth holes, so no skin shows anywhere; a large white ring is stitched round the whole face, and one small red triangle with rounded corners, pointing down, sits high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on both hands; no robot parts. Grain, uneven exposure, no readable signs. Thanks.
